mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS creator_id, c.name AS creator_name, COALESCE(s.total_amount, 0) AS sale_total_amount, COALESCE(s.cnt, 0) AS sale_count, COALESCE(cr.total_amount, 0) AS cancel_total_amount, COALESCE(cr.cnt, 0) AS cancel_count FROM creator c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT crs.creator_id, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sale_record s JOIN course crs ON s.course_id = crs.id WHERE s.paid_at >= #{startAt} AND s.paid_at < #{endAtExclusive} GROUP BY crs.creator_id ) s ON s.creator_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT crs.creator_id, SUM(cr.refund_amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM cancel_record cr JOIN sale_record sr ON cr.sale_record_id = sr.id JOIN course crs ON sr.course_id = crs.id WHERE cr.cancelled_at >= #{startAt} AND cr.cancelled_at < #{endAtExclusive} GROUP BY crs.creator_id ) cr ON cr.creator_id = c.id ORDER BY c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement ( creator_id, settlement_year_month, total_sales, total_refunds, net_sales, fee_rate, fee_amount, settlement_amount, sale_count, cancel_count, status ) VALUES ( #{creatorId}, #{yearMonth}, #{totalSales}, #{totalRefunds}, #{netSales}, #{feeRate}, #{feeAmount}, #{settlementAmount}, #{saleCount}, #{cancelCount}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.select: SELECT id, creator_id AS creatorId, settlement_year_month AS yearMonth, total_sales AS totalSales, total_refunds AS totalRefunds, net_sales AS netSales, fee_rate AS feeRate, fee_amount AS feeAmount, settlement_amount AS settlementAmount, sale_count AS saleCount, cancel_count AS cancelCount, status FROM settlement WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} AND settlement_year_month = #{yearMonth}
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement SET total_sales = #{totalSales}, total_refunds = #{totalRefunds}, net_sales = #{netSales}, fee_rate = #{feeRate}, fee_amount = #{feeAmount}, settlement_amount = #{settlementAmount}, sale_count = #{saleCount}, cancel_count = #{cancelCount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE settlement SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
